description: #120 — the extraction-time mode-stability early-exit (the open half of the sampling policy, METHODOLOGY.md 'Bell Schedule Sampling Policy'). District-grain: Stage 7 stops issuing paid council calls for a district once EVERY fillable target band's running mode is stable (aggregate.mode_stable: cumulative mode on the ±15 grid unchanged over the last `window` schools AND holding ≥ min_share of all values). Unsent reps are recorded as skipped receipts, visible at gate@7, and remain dispatchable (7->6). Probes, GT-scored runs, and batch_00000 are exempt — measurement wants the full census. Read by process_governance/stage7_run.py.
governance: The numeric params are config-as-data ON PURPOSE (Ian, 2026-07-15): changing window/min_n/min_share mid-corpus changes what 'a stable mode' means district to district — methodology drift, reviewed by PR, with this file as the decision log. `enabled` is the ONE operational field the console may flip (Settings view, the gate-mode precedent): the kill-switch is observable and instantly reversible, and skipping is the spend-conservative direction (the auto-act test, #233 precedent) — a wrongly-locked mode is visible at gate@8 and reversible via re-dispatch of the skipped reps.
provenance: bootstrap — window=5/min_n=3/min_share=0.6 as shipped (and unit-tested) in aggregate.mode_stable since the sampling-policy decision (2026-06); first wired live by #120.
